name: Curse of Binding
description:
Once equipped, items with this curse can only be unequipped via death.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 2❤️[/dark-red] to afflict beheld enemies with a psychic virus which binds them in place for 5 seconds. Unarmed kills spread the virus.
